title: Measure power antenna and host conditions
description:
Measure selected power levels, feed losses and applicable antenna/host behavior for the exact configuration. Exercise reviewed startup, retention-sleep, calibration and RF-state conditions where relevant. Evaluate the specified grant integration and RF exposure evidence requirements without assuming one antenna covers every host.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use affirmative matching authority.10 and rf.03 session approvals before ports or RF, not a final grant presumed in advance. No antenna purchase, host modification or external lab booking is implicit. Changed or denied scope keeps execution blocked or deferred regardless of prerequisite closure.
acceptance_criteria: Independent calibrated measurements and documented antenna/host facts support each tested condition, with uncertainty and failing cases retained. Applicable modem errata are tied to actual firmware. Provide authority.12 the measured evidence and gaps; neither a chip power setting nor one passing state proves blanket compliance.
